item.title: AI Disruption in Global Capital Markets
item.content:encoded:
Appel publié par Pacific-Basin Finance Journal. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Artificial intelligence and machine learning applications in financial markets
  • Algorithmic trading and high-frequency trading
  • AI-driven market microstructure and price discovery
  • Systemic risk and financial stability implications of AI
  • Regulatory frameworks and governance of AI in finance
  • Market efficiency and anomalies in AI-dominated markets
  • Risk management and portfolio optimization with AI
  • Ethical considerations and fairness in AI-driven finance
  • Impact on market participants and trading strategies
  • Data quality, bias, and robustness of AI models in finance
